title: The Criterion Collection Drops ‘The Complete Kubrick’: Here’s Where to Shop the Box Set Online
summary: The 30-disc Blu-ray box set comes with 13 of the director's feature films, plus loads of bonus features.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Stanley Kubrick is considered the greatest filmmaker of all time. Not because of his very impressive body of work and attention to detail, but also how he moved the art form forward with his use of music to enhance a scene and story — especially in 2001: A Space Odyssey . And now the Criterion Collection just released a huge box set with all of his films.

On sale for up to 50% off its list price, The Complete Kubrick is the newest addition to the ever-growing Criterion Collection of film titles. You can get just about all of Stanley Kubrick’s movies, such as Dr. Strangelove , A Clockwork Orange , Barry Lyndon and others, restored in 4K Ultra HD picture quality in one massive box set.

In fact, the box set is so big that it includes 30 Blu-ray discs that come with all of the director’s films and full of bonus features covering the filmmaker’s nearly 50-year career.

And speaking of bonus features, the box set has loads of them, including new audio commentaries, restored behind-the-scenes documentaries, archival interviews, short films and amateur films, rare photos and artwork, essays, and other featurettes.

And since this Criterion Collection title is from Barnes & Noble, you can get your order shipped to you for free, if your cart is over $60, or if you’re a member of the retailer’s membership program , $39.99 per year (about $3.33 per month). Premium membership gets you a wide range of benefits, such as free shipping on all orders, early access to special editions and events, an additional 10% off at checkout and more. You can even get a free tote bag (a $24.99 value) with membership.

Meanwhile, if you live near a B&N location, you can order online and opt to pick up your goods in store for free. Learn more about B&N membership and rewards here .

With prices starting at $299.97 (was $599.95), The Complete Kubrick is available across retailers, like B&N , Criterion.com and Amazon . Check out the box set’s trailer below.

Here’s a list of the feature films included in the box set.

- Fear and Desire (1952)

- Killer’s Kiss (1955)

- The Killing (1956)

- Paths of Glory (1957)

- Spartacus (1960)

- Lolita (1962)

- Dr. Strangelove, or How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb (1964)

- 2001: A Space Odyssey (1968)

- A Clockwork Orange (1971)

- Barry Lyndon (1975)

- The Shining (1980)

- Full Metal Jacket (1987)

- Eyes Wide Shut (1999)
